headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while others saw modest or slowing expansion.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. LTM, Tech Mahindra and HCLTech also delivered double‑digit growth, supported by AI‑related deals. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% YoY growth, indicating a slowdown at the larger end. Profit trends were mixed, with HCLTech posting a 21% profit jump while Wipro saw a slight decline.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth, LTM 47% AI growth, HCLTech AI revenue at $219 m, and TCS AI revenue exceeding 10% of total.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% FY27 outlook, reflecting cautious market expectations.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue grew 13.6% YoY with strong AI‑led managed services wins.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and no clear guidance was provided.
